facts.fact: BTW Media reports that ADEX Technology operates its own data centre at Sidi Abdellah, certified by ARPCE since June 2020 and described as Tier II-ready, and sells ADEXCLOUD IaaS to SMEs, corporates and government agencies; no date of operation is given beyond the article's own publication date of 2025-07-15, which is used.

note: Tier II-ready is below Tier III, so no tier3 fact.
